# CFC Mortgage Blog

> Hendersonville, TN home buying and mortgage insights: first-time buyers, VA loans, Old Hickory Lake homes, the Sumner County market, and FHA, VA, USDA, Conventional, Jumbo and HELOC loans.

This blog is published by CFC Mortgage — Hendersonville (Coastal Funding Corporation), with local broker Jay Spurlin. Articles are informational and are not a commitment to lend; rates and programs are subject to change.

## Business

- Lender/broker: Coastal Funding Corporation, NMLS 103035
- Local service area: Hendersonville & Middle Tennessee
- Coverage: Tennessee only (primary-residence purchase and refinance loans for Tennessee homes)
